summary: Innovative Solutions and Support, Inc. filed an 8-K/A (Amendment No. 1, Item 2.01/9.01) supplying the financial statements and pro formas for its previously closed acquisition of Sparton Aydin, LLC (d/b/a Aydin Displays) from Sparton Corporation. Under the Membership Interest Purchase Agreement dated July 21, 2026, IS&S acquired all outstanding membership interests of the Delaware LLC, closing the same day. The amendment adds audited FY2025 and unaudited H1 2026 financials, pro forma condensed combined statements for the nine months ended June 30, 2026 and FY ended September 30, 2025, plus Grant Thornton's consent. No price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed here; watch integration and purchase accounting.
